expectation: Membrane stain on nerve fibres and Schwann/enteric glial cells (myenteric and submucosal plexus ganglia, nerve bundles), pericytes round vessels, and FDC networks in lymphoid follicles. These are a sparse minority of cells, sitting as discrete bundles, ganglia or rings, not whole layers.
observed: A: bowel wall; the whole muscularis propria is bright and even, with fine lines in the mucosa and small rings in the submucosa. B/C: faint haze around the epithelium. D: diffuse yellow haze with no cells. E: CD21 is saturated haze, so it tells nothing; NGFR is mottled texture.
why: The signal fills the whole smooth-muscle layer evenly instead of picking out discrete nerves or ganglia, D shows haze with no cell outlines, and row E cannot be used.
notes: NGFR lights the entire muscularis propria evenly, like autofluorescence or cross-reaction with smooth muscle. There are no discrete plexus or nerve-bundle cells, and the close-up is featureless haze. The small submucosal rings are too weak to carry the verdict.
